full_prompt_en: A square color street photograph shows a pale blue vintage coupe parked along a sunlit curb in front of a small blue house and tall palms. The cloudless sky fills the upper background in a muted, dusty cyan, with several slim palm trunks rising beyond the low roofline. A large, dense palm crown occupies the upper right and casts a deeper green mass against the sky. On the left half, the one-story house has a warm tan roof, faded light-blue stucco walls, one pale-paned window near the left edge, and a narrow dark teal door near the center. A small exterior light sits above the door. To the right of the house, a white wall and gate hold a thick, dark flowering shrub; the wall's shadow falls across its own lower surface. The car stretches horizontally through the lower middle, facing left. Its long hood, two-door cabin, pale roof, slim chrome trim, and circular wheel hubs are clearly visible in profile. The windows appear dark, with only a faint silhouette inside. A broad asphalt street and the curb run across the lower quarter, leaving open pavement in front of the vehicle. Small weeds interrupt the base of the building and the edge of the sidewalk. Harsh midday sunlight falls from high on the left, bleaching the pale paint and wall, while the car and palm foliage make compact dark shadows beneath and behind their forms. The palette is sun-faded rather than bright: powder blue, dusty turquoise, warm beige, muted olive, dark teal, and a little chrome white. Fine film grain and slight softness give the flat wall and sky a tactile, aged quality without obscuring the crisp car outline. The viewpoint is level across the road, and there are no people or readable signs. The overall composition is quiet and strongly horizontal, using the car as a pale band below vertical palms to evoke a still, warm urban afternoon.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形彩色街头照片呈现一辆浅蓝色旧式双门轿车，停在阳光下的路缘，前方是一幢蓝色小屋和高高的棕榈树。无云天空以低调、带灰尘感的青蓝色填满上部背景，几根细长棕榈树干从低矮屋顶后升起。浓密的大棕榈树冠占据右上，在天空前形成较深绿团块。左半部的单层房屋有暖棕色屋顶、褪色浅蓝灰泥墙、靠左缘的一扇浅色窗格，以及近中央的一道狭窄深青色门。门上方有一盏小壁灯。房屋右侧，白墙和门围住一簇浓密深色的开花灌木；墙的阴影落在自己较低的表面。轿车横跨画面下部中央，车头朝左。侧面清楚显出长车头、双门车厢、浅色车顶、细窄镀铬饰条和圆形轮毂。车窗较暗，里面只有模糊身影。宽阔柏油马路与路缘横过下部四分之一，在车前留下开放路面。零星杂草打断建筑基底和人行道边缘。强烈正午阳光从左上方落下，使浅色车漆和墙面泛白，车下与棕榈叶下则形成紧凑深色阴影。色彩呈日晒褪色感而非鲜艳：粉蓝、灰青、暖米、低调橄榄、深青和少量镀铬白。细微胶片颗粒与轻微软化让平坦墙面和天空具有岁月肌理，却没有遮住清晰的车辆轮廓。视点与马路平视，画中没有行人或可读标识。整体构图安静且横向感强，以轿车在竖直棕榈下形成的浅色带，唤起一个静止、温暖的城市午后。
style_prompt_en: The color photograph carries a sun-faded film palette of powder blue, dusty turquoise, warm beige, olive green, and small chrome-white highlights. Strong high daylight makes pale matte areas almost chalky and produces compact, dark shadows beneath solid forms. Broad horizontal bands structure the lower frame, while sparse tall verticals and a dense textured crown break the open upper field. Fine grain and slight optical softness keep uniform areas tactile without losing clear silhouettes. The viewpoint stays level and observational, with ordinary surfaces and proportions rendered plainly. Dark windows and foliage provide the main value anchors against large washed-out walls and sky. Color separation is subtle, with warm and cool tones meeting in quiet blocks rather than saturated gradients. The overall effect is still, warm, and nostalgic, grounded in direct light and understated street-level composition.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色照片带着日晒褪色的胶片色域：粉蓝、灰青、暖米、橄榄绿和小面积镀铬白高光。强烈高位日光让浅色哑光区域近乎粉笔般发白，并在坚实体块下形成紧凑深影。宽阔水平色带组织下半幅，疏落的高竖线和密集有肌理的冠状团块打断开放的上部色域。细微颗粒与轻微镜头柔化让均匀区域可触，却不损失清楚剪影。视点保持平视和观察式，日常表面与比例被朴素地呈现。深色玻璃与叶丛在大片褪色墙面及天空前提供主要明度锚点。色彩分离微妙，冷暖色在安静色块中相接，而非形成高饱和渐层。整体效果静止、温暖、怀旧，扎根于直接日光和克制的街道视角构图。
theme_en: A pale vintage car parked outside a blue house beneath palms
theme_zh: 棕榈树下停在浅蓝色房屋前的一辆淡色旧车
name: Janet Delaney
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
